description:
Connect your Phasio manufacturer account to explore your manufacturing business in ChatGPT. Find orders and parts, review production progress and scrap history, and summarize operational data without manually assembling reports.

Understand how a part was priced, compare hypothetical quotes across quantities and configurations, inspect part geometry, and find similar parts already in your account. Phasio uses your configured pricing equations and customer-specific rates to help explain the results.

Review your manufacturing setup and identify configuration issues affecting quoting. For pricing changes, create and validate an equation version, then compare supported part quotes before a person makes the version live in Phasio. You can also update existing equation versions or delete non-live versions. Updating an existing live equation changes storefront pricing immediately.

Requires an existing Phasio manufacturer account. Available data and features depend on your account's configuration and permissions. Quote calculations do not create orders or send quotes to customers.

defaultPrompt: Help me build a pricing equation for my manufacturing process
How many parts did I make this week?
